name: TD Friends of the Environment Foundation Grant

funder.name: TD Friends of the Environment Foundation

summary: Grants for Canadian charities, municipalities, schools and Indigenous groups running environmental projects such as park revitalization, schoolyard greening, tree planting with native species and citizen science. Does not fund capital costs, operating costs or research.

amount.note: No set minimum or maximum; most grants fall in this range

applicant_types.quote: Organizations eligible to receive funding: Registered Canadian charities with a Charitable Registration Number (CRN) Educational institutions (primary/secondary/post-secondary) Municipalities Indigenous groups/communities

geography.quote: TD FEF can only fund projects taking place in Canada.

access.quote: All grant applications must be submitted online.

window.quote: 2027 Submission Deadlines Winter submission Summer submission Submission deadline December 15, 2026 June 15

amount.quote: there is no set minimum or maximum amount for which you can apply. However, the majority of TD FEF grants are between $2,000 and $8,000.
